message: Similar-code companion `fallow-similar-code` was not found next to the active Fallow executable. For a project that has `fallow` as a devDependency, add the companion at the same version: `npm install --save-dev fallow-similar-code@3.49.0`. For a global `fallow`, run `npm install --global fallow-similar-code@3.49.0`. For npx, start both packages together: `npx -p fallow@3.49.0 -p fallow-similar-code@3.49.0 fallow similar-code status`. The `fallow` npm launcher passes the signed companion binary to Fallow. Project-local executables and PATH are never searched.
